about: Which machine implements which prU ticket. Lanes are content skills (C-<lane>-NN, -refs, -example); explicit ticket ids win over lanes. Only content tickets of web-application, python-testing and python-architecture depend on another lane, so they stay on one machine. Edit this file (and commit it) to move work between machines; never run a ticket on both.

A.about: the first machine (M1, 8 GB): the tickets it had started (L0-05..L0-10, L0-18, L0-20, L0-22, L0-23), docs, F-01 and the cross-lane content cluster

B.about: the second, larger machine: the critical engine chain from L0-07 to L0-15/L0-16 (moved from A on 2026-10-22, owner's request, so the chain runs 6 at a time), L0-24 and the independent content lanes
